generationMode: one original full-canvas scene per call
style: Original black monochrome technical line illustration with confident medium contour, sparse functional hatching, restrained interior detail, generous whitespace, and plain civil-service test-booklet economy. Original subjects and compositions only; do not reconstruct any official sample.
globalExclusions: No text or pseudo-text; no readable signs, labels, letters, numbers, arrows, circles, answer marks, logos, brands, watermarks, decorative borders, color-only cues, cropped meaning-bearing objects, impossible joints or poses, duplicated people or parts, floating objects, dramatic spotlighting, or visual emphasis on the target.

sources.title: 29 CFR 1910.22 General requirements
sources.scope: Walking-working surfaces must be kept clean, orderly, sanitary, and free of hazards such as sharp or protruding objects, loose boards, corrosion, leaks, spills, snow, and ice.

sources.title: 29 CFR 1910.37 Exit routes
sources.scope: Exit routes must be free and unobstructed.

sources.title: 29 CFR 1910.1200 Hazard Communication
sources.scope: Workplace containers of hazardous chemicals must be identified; brief does not infer a chemical identity from appearance.

sources.title: FDA Food Code 2022
sources.scope: Poisonous or toxic materials must be stored so they cannot contaminate food, equipment, utensils, linens, or single-use articles, including not above them. Model-code scope is recorded and not represented as an exam weighting.

sources.title: 29 CFR 1910.334 Use of equipment
sources.scope: Damaged cord-and-plug equipment must be removed from service; equipment used where water contact is likely must be approved for that location.

sources.title: 29 CFR 1910.23 Ladders
sources.scope: Ladders must be inspected, used only on stable and level surfaces unless secured/stabilized, and used according to their design.

sources.title: NIOSH Ergonomic Guidelines for Manual Material Handling
sources.locator: material-handling risk factors and mechanical-aid guidance
sources.scope: Use source-backed broad handling and visibility concepts; do not imply one universal lifting technique.

sources.title: CDC Infection Control — Summary of Recommendations
sources.locator: E.II Cleaning Spills of Blood and Body Substances
sources.scope: Promptly clean and decontaminate spills using protective gloves and task-appropriate PPE. Healthcare guidance is used only for the broad exposure-control concept.

sources.title: FDA Allergen Removal and Transfer Using Wiping and Cleaning Methods
sources.scope: Used wiping materials can transfer contamination; full cleaning minimizes transfer. The scene uses only the broad food-contact cross-contamination concept.

sources.title: 29 CFR 1910.212 General requirements for all machines
sources.scope: Moving parts and exposed fan blades below seven feet require guarding; portable power tools are included among machines commonly requiring point-of-operation guarding.
